system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: injects the patient profile and current datetime as structured context
system_prompt_style.note: Assistant prompt file not in evidence; user-agent prompt uses format_prompt_safe with variables.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: On each turn, the agent receives the full conversation history and the patient profile
env_context_strategy.note: Patient profile is injected into the prompt, and the agent navigates the sandbox via tools such as get_profile and list_medications. No value in the list fits the healthcare setting well.

context_compaction.note: Assistant agent code is truncated from the bundle. The paper says the full history is sent, but no history-processing location was visible.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Every turn is captured in a structured conversation trace (messages, tool calls, and tool results).
observation_format.note: Tool result format not shown; sandbox returns dict data, so this may be JSON.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the assistant is a LangGraph ReAct agent that reasons and acts against the healthcare sandbox
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from LangGraph ReAct tool binding.

tool_count.evidence_quote: providing 15 tools within a stateful sandbox across four categories (appointments, prescriptions, telehealth, and profile management)

edit_primitive.note: The full tool list has no file-editing tool; the domain is healthcare.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each tool ships with a structured natural-language specification of its purpose, required and optional parameters, return format, and behavioral preconditions

protocol_standardization.note: No grep or dependency file available in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The assistant is implemented as a ReAct [Yao et al., 2023] (Reasoning and Acting) agent built using LangGraph

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the prompt does not include few-shot examples, chain-of-thought scaffolding, or model-specific optimizations

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the assistant is a LangGraph ReAct agent that reasons and acts against the healthcare sandbox, while the simulated patient responds in persona
multi_agent_topology.note: The simulated patient belongs to the benchmark environment and is not part of the harness.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a base model wrapped in a LangGraph ReAct harness that reasons over the patient's context and acts through the sandbox tools
delegation_mechanism.note: The tool list, which would be the delegation point, contains no delegation tool.

human_in_loop.note: The simulated patient is the user. Harness code is not shown.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: On each turn, the agent receives the full conversation history and the patient profile
short_term_state.note: The sandbox state is environment state, not agent working state.

state_persistence.note: Resume works at the level of completed conversations and skips them; partial conversations are not resumed. Line number is approximate.

self_verification.evidence_quote: it represents a minimal baseline that any general-purpose LLM should be able to follow
self_verification.note: The LLM jury scores benchmark results after the run; it is not feedback to the agent.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Conversations that encounter unrecoverable agent errors are terminated with an error marker and excluded from aggregate scoring.
retry_policy.note: LLM transport retries (LLM_RETRY_CONFIG) exist but are not task-level retries.

rollback.note: The tool list has cancel_appointment, which is a domain action, not rollback. Code is truncated.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: steps 2–3 repeat for up to 15 turns
termination_condition.note: The user-agent termination signal is an environment stop. The config default is max_turns 10 in the README example.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The sandbox is generated at the start of each conversation using LLM
execution_isolation.note: Tools run in-process on a simulated Python data store.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: is the shared mutable data store that all tools read from and write to during the conversation
filesystem_access.note: No filesystem is involved; the agent works on an in-memory simulated data store.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Run the test suite (no AWS credentials or network access required)
network_policy.note: Tools have no network capability; this is a closest-value fit.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every turn is captured in a structured conversation trace (messages, tool calls, and tool results).

guardrails.note: The prompt contains safety rules, but no harness-level guardrail code was shown.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
evaluates patient-facing health AI agents through realistic,
multi-turn conversations in primary care contexts

open_source.note: CC BY-NC is not an OSI licence, but the full source is released. Closest-value fit.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
any role (assistant,
simulated patient, evaluator, sandbox, seed generator, analyzer) can use any of them

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This repository hosts the reference implementation for the paper
primary_artifact.note: The code is frozen to the paper; no PRs are accepted.

first_release_date.note: No tag or first-commit date was available, so the paper v1 date is used.

pinned_version.evidence_quote: This repository hosts the reference implementation for the paper
pinned_version.note: The ref comes from the evidence header, commit:main c9bfa1b57253. The quote only identifies the repository; the commit and date are not in any quotable evidence text. Short hash only; no tag.

stars.note: The star count comes from the evidence header, not from a dated gh api call. The header date shown is the commit date (2026-07-29), not the date the stars were retrieved. The locator points at the evidence header, not a file line.
